backends.name: relic (native)
backends.notes: Serves through relic_native, the native HTTP adapter new in Relic 2.0 (app.serveNative).

implementation.concurrency: one Dart isolate per core (2, noOfIsolates)

backends.name: relic (native-fixed)
backends.notes: relic_native with a fix: while handlers wait on their own I/O, its drain gives the event loop a few turns and then parks, instead of lingering 1 ms in the kernel, which held database replies (app/patches/).

implementation.concurrency: one Dart isolate per core (2, noOfIsolates)

backends.name: serverpod (relic-2.0.0)
backends.notes: Serverpod 4.1.1 with Relic overridden to the final 2.0.0 release, still served through relic_io. One Dart isolate, like the default build.

implementation.server: Serverpod 4 built-in server (production mode, monolith role)
implementation.concurrency: one Dart isolate, single-threaded event loop (uses one core)
implementation.db_access: Serverpod ORM over its own Postgres driver

backends.name: serverpod (relic-native-fixed-2.0.0)
backends.notes: As relic-native-2.0.0, with relic_native's drain fix: while handlers wait on the database it yields to the event loop, then parks, instead of lingering 1 ms. One Dart isolate.

implementation.server: Serverpod 4 built-in server (production mode, monolith role)
implementation.concurrency: one Dart isolate, single-threaded event loop (uses one core)
implementation.db_access: Serverpod ORM over its own Postgres driver
